skill.name: gws-drive
skill.description: Manage Google Drive files, folders, shared drives, permissions, comments, revisions, and change tracking through the gws CLI.
skill.summary: Use gws Drive commands to inspect and manage Google Drive resources.
skill.author: googleworkspace

content.user_title: Manage Google Drive with AI Agents
content.value_statement: Drive administration can require many resource-specific commands and parameters. This skill maps Google Drive resources to gws commands so Claude, Codex, and Claude Code can manage files with context.
actual_capabilities: Lists files, shared drives, comments, permissions, revisions, and changes through gws drive resources.
Gets metadata or content for Drive files, comments, replies, apps, operations, and approvals.
Creates, updates, copies, exports, downloads, and watches Drive files when authorized.
Manages shared drives, access proposals, comments, replies, permissions, labels, and revisions.
Uses gws schema guidance to inspect method parameters before calling an API method.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and authenticated Google Workspace access.
Does not include the shared authentication instructions inside this skill file.
Drive API permissions control what data and actions are available.
Large exports, revisions, and media operations follow Google Drive API limits.

use_cases.title: Manage Team File Operations
use_cases.description: Find files, inspect sharing, and manage shared drives during team changes.

use_cases.title: Review Drive Access
use_cases.description: Review permissions, comments, revisions, and access proposals before compliance audits.

use_cases.title: Investigate Drive Incidents
use_cases.description: Download approved files and check operations or change history during support cases.

prompt_templates.title: Find Drive Files
prompt_templates.prompt: List my Google Drive files matching [topic]. Show names, owners, modified dates, and whether each file is trashed.

prompt_templates.title: Review Folder Sharing
prompt_templates.prompt: For folder [folder ID], list permissions and identify users or groups with writer or owner access. Do not change anything.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a File Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare to update file [file ID] with approved content from [source]. Inspect the schema first and ask before applying changes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Shared Drive Permissions
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit shared drive [drive ID]. List current permissions, propose exact role changes, and wait for approval before applying them.

output_examples.input: Find recent project plan documents in Drive.
output_examples.output: A concise list of matching documents sorted by modified date, with owners, file types, and sharing status.

output_examples.input: Review sharing for a shared drive before vendor access.
output_examples.output: A permission review that separates owners, writers, commenters, readers, and external accounts.

output_examples.input: Prepare replies to unresolved comments on a file.
output_examples.output: A confirmation checklist with current comments, proposed replies, and no changes applied until approval.

best_practices: Inspect the schema before every method call and fill only required parameters.
Ask for confirmation before downloads, permission changes, deletion, or content updates.
Use narrow fields and queries to limit returned Drive data.
anti_patterns: Do not request all fields when only names or IDs are needed.
Do not change sharing settings without naming the affected users and roles.
Do not download or export sensitive files without a clear user request.

faq.question: What does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It manages Drive files, folders, shared drives, permissions, comments, replies, revisions, changes, and related metadata.

faq.question: Does it require Google authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. The gws CLI must be installed and authenticated with suitable Google Workspace permissions.

faq.question: Can it upload files?
faq.answer: The base skill documents create and update operations. A companion upload helper is referenced for automatic metadata handling.

faq.question: Can it modify sharing permissions?
faq.answer: Yes, when the authenticated account has permission. Confirm changes before creating, updating, or deleting permissions.

faq.question: Does it work with shared drives?
faq.answer: Yes. It can list, create, update, hide, unhide, and inspect shared drives.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
